plan.title: Plan
plan.cloudDescription: Your hosted beta status and optional pricing feedback.
plan.selfHostDescription: The application plan for this deployment.
plan.selfHostBody: This instance runs on infrastructure you operate. Bisibility does not charge a subscription or per-keyword license fee for the self-hosted app.
plan.selfHostCosts: Infrastructure, provider requests and optional services remain your costs.

budgetDialog.title: Provider budgets
budgetDialog.description: Set a monthly budget for each provider. Using the provider balance includes this month's usage so the remaining budget matches the available balance.
budgetDialog.descriptionWithCredits: Set monthly budgets for each provider. Your keys and credits have separate budgets. Using a balance includes this month's usage so the remaining budget matches the available balance.
budgetDialog.appColumnHelp: Checks you start in the app and automatic scheduled checks.
budgetDialog.programmaticColumnHelp: Requests from the API, MCP, SDK and CLI. Set it to protect against runaway agents.
budgetDialog.creditBalanceUnavailable: A positive credit balance is unavailable. Enter a budget manually.
budgetDialog.creditsProgrammaticBudgetField: {provider} credits API, MCP and SDK budget
budgetDialog.consequence: When a budget is reached, the requests of that surface stop until next month; the other surface keeps running.
budgetDialog.emptyAfterLink: to set a monthly budget for it.
budgetDialog.positiveUnits: Enter a positive number of searches.
budgetDialog.invalidDecimal: Enter a positive amount with up to two decimals.
budgetDialog.wholeUnits: Enter a whole number of searches.
budgetDialog.tooLargeBudget: Enter a monthly budget at or below {maximum}.
budgetDialog.balanceUnavailable: A positive provider balance is unavailable. Enter a budget manually.

budgetDialog.refreshError: Provider balance could not be refreshed. Enter a budget manually.
budgetDialog.saveError: Provider budget could not be saved.
budgetDialog.splitNotice: Your previous budget now applies to each of the two separately. Adjust if you want a different split.
budgetDialog.nativeBalanceHelp: This is the provider account balance, not scoped usage or a monthly budget.
